items.title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation
items.title_zh: Arabic-DeepSeek-R1：稀疏 MoE 微调与思维链蒸馏驱动的阿拉伯语 SOTA 建模
items.summary: Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 fine-tunes a sparse MoE backbone with a four-phase chain-of-thought distillation scheme and a 372M-token, contamination-controlled 80/20 Arabic-English mixture. The authors report the highest average score across the seven-benchmark Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard and state-of-the-art or near-state-of-the-art results on MadinahQA, AraTrust, AlGhafa and ALRAGE, outperforming GPT-5.1 on the majority of evaluated benchmarks.

items.title: DataSTORM: Deep Research on Large-Scale Databases using Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling
items.title_zh: DataSTORM：基于探索性数据分析与数据叙事的超大规模数据库深度研究
items.summary: DataSTORM reframes deep research over structured databases as a thesis-driven process of discovering candidate theses, validating them through iterative cross-source investigation and developing coherent analytical narratives. It reaches a new state of the art on InsightBench with a 19.4% relative improvement in insight-level recall and 7.2% in summary-level score, and outperforms ChatGPT Deep Research on a new ACLED-based dataset in automated and human evaluations.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory：团队级 AI Agent 记忆中枢
items.summary: TencentDB Agent Memory is a TypeScript team-level memory hub that turns conversations, documents and code into four reusable memory assets—Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki and Code-Graph—governed and shared across agents and frameworks.

items.title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework
items.title_zh: Paper Circle：开源多智能体科研发现与分析框架
items.summary: Paper Circle combines a discovery pipeline that merges offline and online retrieval, multi-criteria scoring and diversity-aware ranking with an analysis pipeline that converts papers into typed knowledge graphs of concepts, methods, experiments and figures. Both pipelines run in a coder-LLM multi-agent framework and emit reproducible JSON, CSV, BibTeX, Markdown and HTML at each agent step, and the authors report consistent retrieval and review-generation gains with stronger agent models.

items.title: Toward a universal foundation model for graph-structured data
items.title_zh: 迈向图结构数据的通用基础模型
items.summary: The authors pretrain a feature-agnostic graph foundation model on heterogeneous graphs by encoding degree, centrality, community and diffusion signatures as structural prompts for a message-passing backbone. The pretrained model matches or exceeds strong supervised baselines and transfers zero-shot or few-shot to held-out graphs, reaching 95.5% mean ROC-AUC on SagePPI after supervised fine-tuning, a 21.8% gain over the best supervised message-passing baseline.

items.title: Application-Driven Pedagogical Knowledge Optimization of Open-Source LLMs via Reinforcement Learning and Supervised Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 通过强化学习与监督微调实现开源 LLM 的教学知识优化
items.summary: EduQwen 32B models combine progressive-difficulty reinforcement learning with supervised fine-tuning on difficulty-weighted synthetic data to strengthen pedagogical knowledge in a dense Qwen3-32B backbone. The authors report state-of-the-art accuracy on the Cross-Domain Pedagogical Knowledge benchmark and the interactive Pedagogy Benchmark Leaderboard, surpassing larger proprietary systems including the previous leader Gemini-3 Pro.

items.title: MedConclusion: A Benchmark for Biomedical Conclusion Generation from Structured Abstracts
items.title_zh: MedConclusion：从结构化摘要生成生物医学结论的基准
items.summary: MedConclusion pairs non-conclusion sections of 5.7 million PubMed structured abstracts with author-written conclusions to benchmark biomedical conclusion generation. Initial evaluations find that conclusion writing is behaviorally distinct from summarizing and that judge identity can substantially shift scores.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.title_zh: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian：基于 Obsidian 与 Claude Code 的自组织第二大脑
items.summary: Claude Obsidian is a Python-based, self-organizing second brain for Obsidian and Claude Code that reads, links and files dropped sources into a connected Markdown knowledge graph. It follows Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
